name: Space-Time Tomographic Projection (STP) Regularizer
definition: A regularization term for volume reconstruction that aggregates gradient information from a local neighborhood (patch) of voxels using a structure tensor, rather than just the gradient at a single voxel. It solves the problem of isotropic smoothing by allowing anisotropic regularization based on local structure.
summary: The Space-Time Tomographic Projection Regularizer is a non-local term that recovers thin manifolds by aggregating local gradients into structure tensors, differing from standard Total Variation through anisotropic, patch-based regularization.
